fusions.name: Bank Lunge
fusions.desc: You lunge up to 6 tiles at an enemy at or below 30% health, dealing 22 damage, up to 1.3 times as much from 6.5 tiles away, and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wallow Lash
fusions.desc: You whip your tail through the mud, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back, with a 40% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lying in the Silt
fusions.desc: You sink into the ground and are veiled for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You carry 6% physical resistance.
